search.snippet: The jar of swamp is a rare drop from Zulrah. The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of Zulrah. Doing so requires having defeated Zulrah at least once. A large display of Zulrah in her poisonous lair.
search.title: Jar of Swamp - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: The jar of swamp is a rare drop from Zulrah. Players who attempt to open it, will have the chatbox display the message The jar can be used on a boss lair display in a player's Achievement Gallery to have a display of Zulrah. Doing so requires having defeated Zulrah at least once. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com •The examine is a reference to the movie Shrek. See full list on oldschoolrunescape.fandom.com This is my Swamp! You put the Jar of Swamp on the Zulrah boss lair display in the Achievement Gallery of your player-owned house (POH) in Old School RuneScape. So if you take the drop rate of the Jar of Swamp, plus the drop rate of an Elite Clue Scroll from Zulrah. All you have to do to get the answer you're looking for is add those 2 drop rates together and divide it by the amount of total drops that Zulrah actually has on it's drop table. After hearing about the recently discovered Easter Egg for the Jar of Souls I figured I might try my hand at finding the Easter Egg for the Jar of Swamp. So far to no avail. I'm here to ask if any of you have tried to find the Easter Egg, and what you have tried.

intelligence.economy_brief: The OSRS market is in a normal patch window with subdued price pressure and elevated breadth. Turnover is modestly positive while liquidity stress remains elevated, and the shallowest book depth is concentrated in high-spread, low-volume names.
intelligence.market_mood: Cautious and range-bound; participants are prioritizing cost of entry and fill probability over aggressive reversion, producing low-volatility, low-alpha conditions.
intelligence.regime: Normal patch window (not an update cycle); deterministic news flow is quiet, macro/microstructure metrics indicate a compressed risk-appetite regime.
intelligence.research_summary: Deterministic setup implies price discovery is rule-driven; cross-wallet edges arise from differential risk-budgeting and microstructure timing rather than exogenous news. Current regime favors strategies with tight spread capture, low inventory risk, and high fill probability.
intelligence.summary: Breadth is slightly positive (5.9% advancers) but turnover-weighted pressure is near flat. Market depth is thin and spread dispersion is high, with the thinnest liquidity in lower-tier items.
